title: a hash index filled until a bucket splits, then skewed until a bucket overflows

steps.note: an empty hash index: page 0 is the metapage, then two bucket pages and a bitmap page.
80 keys: 40 per bucket on average, the most the index allows before it splits.
the 81st key tips it over: bucket 2 appears, and only bucket 0's tuples are rehashed into it.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO h SELECT 42 FROM generate_series(1, 600)
steps.note: 600 copies of 42. they keep the split counter running, but splits can't separate equal hashes: 42's bucket chains overflow pages.
